text: EFFIS Fire Weather Index peaks at 26.2 — 'high' on the EFFIS scale — at Navarrete (stage 7) on 2026-10-02, across a 3-day forecast from 2026-10-02. 3 stage endpoint(s) reach 'high' (>= 21.3) or worse: Navarrete (stage 7) 26, Navarrete (stage 7) 24, Alcanadre (stage 9) 23, Logroño (stage 8) 22. FWI anomaly at Navarrete is +2.6 versus the seasonal norm. Reported because: changed. Classes: low <11.2, moderate 11.2-21.3, high 21.3-38, very high 38-50, extreme 50-70, very extreme >70.
